description: A tempo clock with a numeric display, three square-wave outputs at half, one and twice the beat, and gold-ringed jacks carrying the tempo itself as a voltage for the other Catro/Modulo modules

params.text: Sets the tempo, 0 to 500 bpm, read out on the display
Restarts the internal clock when pressed and drives the reset output to 10V while it is held down
Sets the step the tempo knob moves in across its three positions: 0.01, 1 or 5 bpm

inputs.text: Measures the tempo of a clock patched here and adds it to the tempo knob; it locks on after two pulses of equal spacing and holds that tempo until the spacing changes
Adds to the tempo, 1V for every 60 bpm, where the maker's manual says 1V for every 50 bpm; every output except the plain tempo voltage follows the sum
Restarts the internal clock on a rising edge and drives the reset output to 10V while the voltage here is away from zero

outputs.text: The tempo as a voltage, 1V for every 60 bpm, taken before the + input is added
The tempo with the + input added, as a voltage, 1V for every 60 bpm
Half the tempo as a voltage, 1V for every 60 bpm
Twice the tempo as a voltage, 1V for every 60 bpm
A 0-10V square wave at one pulse every two beats, half of each cycle high
A 0-10V square wave at one pulse per beat, half of each cycle high
A 0-10V square wave at two pulses per beat, half of each cycle high
10V while the reset button is held down or the reset input is away from zero, for restarting the other modules at the same moment

notes: the tempo knob comes up at 0 bpm, so the module makes no pulses at all until it is turned up or a clock is patched to the ext input
the gold-ringed jacks throughout Catro/Modulo carry a tempo as a voltage rather than as pulses; chain one module's tempo output into the next module's tempo input to hold them all at one tempo

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
